listing.name: THREAT DETECTED
listing.aiSummary: Adds a challenging scenario featuring fabricators and fleet production limits.

description: Adds a scenario where fabricators spontaneously explode if there are more than two. Limits the maximum producible DP to roughly double the fleet's expected amount. Prioritizes reaching two fabricators.
